method: Compiled ESM harness; fresh process per run; five batches; see README for iterations, warmup and interpretation.
caveats: Early exploratory runs before 05b used a single warmup batch; later runs use at least 200 ms.
00-baseline-sandstorm omitted because it overlapped test execution.
Scaling uses 100 iterations; short-case repeats in 15 use 10000.
Native addon allocations are not measured.

arenaInstrumentation.method: Count calls and source buffer bytes in SingleSegmentArena.allocate; compare original fixed growth with retained geometric growth. Not V8 heap allocation counts.
